verdict: No coherent SOC/Ops capability exists. Current probes, domain ledgers, and static audits are disconnected primitives.

threat_control_proof_gaps.threat: A privileged, network, secret, or service compromise persists undetected between manual probes.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_control: Node-local periodic capability-aware collector and durable append-only operations evidence ledger.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_proof: Ordered signed/hashed samples with collection capability, timestamp, freshness deadline, and retention policy.

threat_control_proof_gaps.threat: A denied probe is rendered as a failed subsystem, producing false incidents and unsafe remediation.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_control: Typed observation outcome model separating measured failure, blocked authority, unavailable capability, timeout, and unknown.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_proof: Every sample carries outcome plus observer principal/capability provenance.

threat_control_proof_gaps.threat: Secret exposure through command line, environment, logs, or reports is not detected or correlated.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_control: Secret-handling posture probes and redaction-preserving security event producer.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_proof: Presence/provenance-only event; no secret material in the event payload. NET-SEC-001 is a demonstrated instance.

threat_control_proof_gaps.threat: Service crash loops, TLS expiry, DNS drift, WireGuard staleness, and artifact-store absence are seen once but not alerted on.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_control: Pure alert rules over retained samples with per-rule freshness window, threshold, dedupe key, and escalation state.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_proof: Alert transition records: opened, acknowledged, mitigated, resolved, and post-resolution read-back.

threat_control_proof_gaps.threat: Desired topology/configuration silently diverges from deployed DNS, listeners, routes, certificates, and service identities.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_control: Topology hash projection and desired-vs-observed reconciliation samples per node/context/attachment.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_proof: Signed topology version/hash and per-node projection read-back.

threat_control_proof_gaps.threat: The installed runtime binary and the binary issuing observations differ, invalidating the evidence source.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_control: Artifact identity attestation as mandatory collector envelope data.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_proof: Executable path, digest, declared release identity, and mismatch status.

threat_control_proof_gaps.threat: No forensic chain exists for access, privilege, mutation, service lifecycle, or network changes.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_control: Structured event adapters for bounded system logs/audit records and CYNIC mutation receipts, with retention and integrity policy.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_proof: Correlatable event IDs and evidence references; raw secrets and unbounded chat/process content excluded.

threat_control_proof_gaps.threat: Metrics dashboards present percentages without scope, denominator, or target provenance.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_control: Metric catalog declaring scope, dimensions, formula, target, source types, and unknown semantics.
threat_control_proof_gaps.missing_proof: Catalog reference embedded in every rollup; host-local coverage cannot claim fleet coverage.

minimum_capability_architecture.protocol: cynic-protocol owns pure ObservationSample, ObservationOutcome, MetricDefinition, AlertRule, AlertTransition, and IncidentRecord contracts
minimum_capability_architecture.host: cynic-host owns injected read-only substrate adapters; it never infers remote host state from local failure
minimum_capability_architecture.node: cynic-node owns node-local sample collection, local durable append-only ledger, freshness scheduling, and local alert evaluation
minimum_capability_architecture.kernel: cynic-kernel consumes federated summaries and coordinates disclosed incidents; it does not claim raw host truth
minimum_capability_architecture.cli: cynic-cli projects node/fleet read-backs and explicitly displays scope, freshness, blocked, and unknown
minimum_capability_architecture.storage: node-local append-only evidence first; federation replication is a later explicit transport contract, never required to preserve local evidence
minimum_capability_architecture.security: security events store classification, provenance, and evidence references only; secrets and raw credential-bearing command lines are prohibited

non_goals: No generic SIEM vendor, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry collector, Elasticsearch, or dashboard dependency before contracts and node-local evidence are operational.
No central kernel collector that turns a network partition into loss of local evidence.
No automatic remediation from alert state; alerts select bounded plans and require their own apply/read-back authority.
